findings.title: Pours come within 0.21 mm of the barrier slot wall on every layer
findings.detail: JLC routed-edge copper clearance is 0.30 mm; a 0.2 mm setback can leave inner-layer copper exposed in the slot after routing tolerance

findings.title: Barrier slot is drawn on the Outline layer as a 2.5 mm stroked path, not a closed cut-out contour
findings.detail: D103 C,2.5: a fab reading the profile layer must interpret a wide stroke as a routed slot; the saved board carries it as a board cut-out region, so an ODB++/IPC-2581 export or a drawn contour removes the ambiguity

findings.title: A .GKO (keep-out) file with an 11.5 x 3.9 mm rectangle is in the fabrication set
findings.detail: fabs that take GKO as the profile when present would cut the wrong board; the keep-out region under U2 should not be output, or the file dropped from the order zip

findings.title: No fiducials and no test points on the board
findings.detail: a 95-part double-sided board going to machine assembly needs two or three fiducials per side; the only probe points are component pads

findings.title: J2-to-shunt pours rise ~21 C at 10 A (IPC-2221, 1 oz, top only)
findings.detail: 4.6 mm wide copper carrying 10 A; a second copper layer or 2 oz halves it

shunt_path.note: IPC-2221 external conductor, 1 oz; the pours are top-layer only
